working_tree_note: FlightReady v2 was implemented in the uncommitted working tree produced by the preceding validation task. The file hashes below, rather than the base commit alone, define the frozen method.

v2_scorecard.aggregation: weighted geometric mean over measured applicable metrics; any measured zero with positive weight preserves a zero
v2_scorecard.primary_score_rule: primary_quality_score is present only when weighted evidence coverage equals 1.0
v2_scorecard.measured_score_rule: measured_quality_score summarizes measured evidence only and is always labeled as such
v2_scorecard.bounds: unavailable applicable metrics are assigned 0 and 100 respectively for lower and upper geometric bounds
v2_scorecard.coverage: sum of measured applicable metric weights divided by all applicable metric weights; not-applicable metrics are excluded
v2_scorecard.missing_evidence: unavailable evidence is retained in coverage and is never treated as pass or zero quality
decision_order: ASSESSMENT_ERROR when any applicable metric is error
NOT_READY when any measured blocking gate fails
INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when a blocking gate is unknown or coverage is below 0.8
CONDITIONALLY_READY when any measured warning gate fails
v2_scorecard.interpretation: quality-criteria summary, not predicted model accuracy

adaptive_profile.applicability: component task and modality allowlists in the frozen adaptive profile
adaptive_profile.gates: technical block/review gates and confirmed hard/preferred requirements are evaluated independently of scores

experimental_protocol_lock.runtime_bug_policy: Only the smallest compatibility correction may be applied; disclose it and preserve the primary frozen result.

reference_modes.reference_free: dataset-internal observations only; no clean labels, corruption manifest, expected counts, or test-set information
reference_modes.reference_assisted: trusted clean annotations and acquisition manifest explicitly labeled oracle-assisted
reference_modes.limited_audit: a deterministic trusted subset, reported separately from full-oracle assistance
